designSummary: Multi-site qualitative study with CFIR-guided framework analysis and a matrix comparison of higher- and lower-performing sites.
sampleSize: Sampling follows information power rather than a calculation: about 8 to 10 interviews per site (40 to 50 in total) across professions and shifts, with at least two night-shift staff per site, plus two observation shifts per site. The research nurse's two days a week over four months give about 34 fieldwork days, enough for this plan. Sampling within a site stops when two consecutive interviews add no new CFIR construct.
primaryAnalysis: Rapid qualitative analysis with structured summaries per interview, then framework analysis using CFIR constructs with inductive codes for anything outside CFIR; each construct rated for valence and strength by site; matrix comparison of the two highest- and two lowest-performing sites.
secondaryAnalysis: Negative case analysis; day and night accounts compared; a short feedback report for each site.
missingData: Not applicable in the statistical sense; gaps in coverage, such as no night-shift physician at a site, are reported as limitations.
multiplicity: Not applicable; no hypothesis tests are performed.
software: NVivo; CFIR codebook and rating rules fixed before coding.
overfittingGuards: Codebook and rating rules fixed before coding, with inductive codes allowed
Double coding of 20 percent of interviews
Performance figures withheld from coders until ratings are done
summary: Information power sampling of 40 to 50 interviews and 10 observation shifts; CFIR framework analysis with a high-low contrast.
